bodytext:
Summer sampling runs monthly between May and September, on a fixed date in the first week of the month. Rounds may be moved for weather but not for river condition.

Twelve points below the weir are sampled by hand. Where a point is unreachable, the round is recorded as incomplete and the value is left empty rather than substituted from the nearest point.
text:
Summer sampling runs fortnightly between May and September. Rounds may be brought forward when the network shows a temperature threshold has been crossed, so that an event is sampled while it is happening rather than three weeks later.

The twelve points below the weir stay. Three new points are added upstream of the confluence, and an unreachable point is still recorded as empty.
